scope: Selected external results and research implications; complements related-work.md

entries.reported_result: Machine-checked safety proof for a realistic Rust subset, with obligations for unsafe libraries.
limits: Not all production Rust implementations
No measured agent construction advantage
Not general functional correctness
entries.lobo_implication: Separate language guarantees from agent construction success.

entries.conditions: ArXiv v3, 189 Lean tasks; abstract's best-model single-trial results for o3, not a current leaderboard
limits: Different foundational tasks, not one end-to-end probability
Specification evaluation uses tests when proofs are inconclusive
No controlled cross-language comparison
entries.lobo_implication: Evaluate specifications, implementations and proofs separately.

entries.conditions: ArXiv v1, verification hints for more than 750 existing programs
entries.reported_result: Best reported model/prompt configuration reaches 68% verification success.
limits: Hint generation is not full construction
Do not merge later results with v1
entries.lobo_implication: Distinguish verifier-loop success from solving the original requirement.

entries.evidence_kind: author-reported multilingual benchmark; selected methods inspected
entries.conditions: ArXiv v1, 3920 problems across 20 languages, model-dependent scores
entries.reported_result: Per-language problem generation and approximate translation for 14 languages.
limits: Different language problem pools
Columns do not isolate construct effects
Generated tests do not prove completeness
entries.lobo_implication: Use matched requirements and independent validation.

entries.evidence_kind: author artifacts and self-reported benchmark; not replicated
entries.conditions: Pinned VeraBench README, nine models, 60 graded problems, single runs; headline against Vera v0.1.8
limits: Ceiling effects
Full-spec and NL modes differ
T1-T4 guidance differs from five-tier headline scope
Disclosed Python/TypeScript grading asymmetry
Raw attempts not obtained and documented as ignored
Training absence and typing causality are unverified author claims
entries.lobo_implication: Control specification information, include existing typed languages and test harder changes.

entries.reported_result: Reanalysis undermines broad language/defect associations; remaining effect sizes are very small.
limits: Not an agent experiment
Correlation does not identify construct effects
entries.lobo_implication: Control domain, task and tools; avoid universal language rankings.

entries.evidence_kind: published generation intervention; selected methods inspected
entries.reported_result: Type-constrained decoding improves compiler acceptance and functional correctness in evaluated TypeScript tasks.
limits: Not ordinary compiler feedback
Emulated support outside the implemented subset
Not all autonomous development
entries.lobo_implication: Separate generator, language constructs and feedback interventions.

entries.hypothesis: Appropriate checked constructs improve acceptance and requirement-preserving changes at a fixed resource budget.
limits: Not measured in Lobo
Existing Lobo trials vary workflow, not language or constructs
Token reduction alone is insufficient evidence
entries.lobo_implication: Make construction quality primary; retain tokens as one cost dimension.
